lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘੜਿ ਭੰਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape hee ghaR bha(n)n savaarahi naanak naam suhaavaniaa ||8||5||6||
lines.translation: You Yourself create, destroy and adorn. O Nanak, we are adorned and embellished with the Naam. ||8||5||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ghat aape bhoganahaaraa ||
lines.translation: He is the Enjoyer of all hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਖੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: alakh varatai agam apaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Invisible, Inaccessible and Infinite is pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad meraa har prabh dhiaaeeai sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: Meditating on my Lord God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am intuitively absorbed in the Truth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree gurasabad ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who implant the Word of the Guru's Shabad in their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad soojhai taa man siu loojhai manasaa maar samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When someone understands the Shabad, then he wrestles with his own mind; subduing his desires, he merges with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਹਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch doot muhahi sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: The five enemies are plundering the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe sudh na saaraa ||
lines.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand or appreciate this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s apanaa ghar raakhai pa(n)ch doot sabad pachaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Those who become Gurmukh-their houses are protected. The five enemies are destroyed by the Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik guramukh sadaa sachai ra(n)g raate ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are forever imbued with love for the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje prabh sevahi anadin maate ||
lines.translation: They serve God with intuitive ease. Night and day, they are intoxicated with His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mil preetam sache gun gaavahi har dar sobhaa paavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Meeting with their Beloved, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True one; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਮ ਏਕੈ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekam ekai aap upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: First, the One created Himself;

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dubidhaa doojaa tribidh maaiaa ||
lines.translation: second, the sense of duality; third, the three-phased Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਥੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਊਚੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: chauthee pauRee guramukh oochee sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: The fourth state, the highest, is obtained by the Gurmukh, who practices Truth, and only Truth. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh hai sachaa je sache bhaavai ||
lines.translation: Everything which is pleasing to the True Lord is true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin sach jaataa so sahaj samaavai ||
lines.translation: Those who know the Truth merge in intuitive peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh karanee sache sevahi saache jaai samaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: The life-style of the Gurmukh is to serve the True Lord. He goes and blends with the True Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sache baajhahu ko avar na dooaa ||
lines.translation: Without the True One, there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਜਗੁ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai laag jag khap khap mooaa ||
lines.translation: Attached to duality, the world is distracted and distressed to death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s eko jaanai eko sev sukh paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh knows only the One. Serving the One, peace is obtained. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh saran tumaaree ||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures are in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕਚੀ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape dhar dekhahi kachee pakee saaree ||
lines.translation: You place the chessmen on the board; You see the imperfect and the perfect as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: anadin aape kaar karaae aape mel milaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: Night and day, You cause people to act; You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape melahi vekhahi hadoor ||
lines.translation: You Yourself unite, and You see Yourself close at hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mahi aap rahiaa bharapoor ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are totally pervading amongst all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੬॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aape aap varatai guramukh sojhee paavaniaa ||8||6||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, God Himself is pervading and permeating everywhere; only the Gurmukhs understand this. ||8||6||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee gur kee meethee ||
lines.translation: The Nectar of the Guru's Bani is very sweet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh viralai kinai chakh deethee ||
lines.translation: Rare are the Gurmukhs who see and taste it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar paragaas mahaa ras peevai dar sachai sabad vajaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Divine Light dawns within, and the supreme essence is found. In the True Court, the Word of the Shabad vibrates. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree gur charanee chit laavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur hai a(n)mrit sar saachaa man naavai mail chukaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the True Pool of Nectar; bathing in it, the mind is washed clean of all filth. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਚੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa sache kinai a(n)t na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Your limits, O True Lord, are not known to anyone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad kinai viralai chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: Rare are those who, by Guru's Grace, focus their consciousness on You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tudh saalaahi na rajaa kabahoo(n) sache naavai kee bhukh laavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Praising You, I am never satisfied; such is the hunger I feel for the True Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko vekhaa avar na beeaa ||
lines.translation: I see only the One, and no other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee a(n)mrit peeaa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad tikhaa nivaaree sahaje sookh samaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: My thirst is quenched by the Word of the Guru's Shabad; I am absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratan padaarath palar tiaagai ||
lines.translation: The Priceless Jewel is discarded like straw;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa doojai bhaai laagai ||
lines.translation: the blind self-willed manmukhs are attached to the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jo beejai soee phal paae supanai sukh na paavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: As they plant, so do they harvest. They shall not obtain peace, even in their dreams. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: apanee kirapaa kare soee jan paae ||
lines.translation: Those who are blessed with His Mercy find the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad ma(n)n vasaae ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides in the mind.
